name: Hallasan
note: East rim summit (한라산 동릉 정상), where the trails end. The true summit on the west rim of the crater is closed to hikers.

name: Mauna Kea
note: Where the summit hike tops out (4,200 m). The summit cone, Puʻu Wēkiu, is about 250 m further on and is a sacred site visitors are asked not to climb.
